name: threesmith
stderr:
Usage: threesmith [options] [command]

Makes coding agents better at three.js: version-pinned API lookup, scored
review, headless check.

Options:
  -V, --version                   output the version number
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  api [options] <query>           Look up a three.js class, constant or member
                                  in the installed version
  search [options] <query>        Search the installed three.js API by name
  review [options] [path]         Scored review of the three.js code in a
                                  directory or file
  fix [options] [path]            Apply the mechanical fixes of the review
                                  (renames with the same meaning); dry run
                                  unless --write
  check [options] <target>        Open a page in headless Chromium (software
                                  WebGL 2) and report problems; optional
                                  screenshot baseline
  inspect [options] <target>      Open the page headless and show the live scene
                                  graph, camera, renderer stats, GPU memory
                                  growth and why objects are not visible
  explain [options] [message...]  Explain a three.js error or warning (console,
                                  build or test output): likely cause and fix.
                                  Reads stdin when no text is given
  play [options] <target>         Run steps in the page headless, watch values
                                  in the live scene and judge claims; --save
                                  keeps a passing run as a scenario
  scenario [options] <op> [name]  List or run the scenarios kept in
                                  .threesmith/scenarios (regression tests made
                                  from play runs)
  perf [options] <target>         Measure draw calls, triangles, programs,
                                  textures and frame times against a budget and
                                  the last run
  leaks [options] <target>        Repeat a cycle of steps and report what grows
                                  per cycle (GPU resources never disposed, by
                                  type)
  build [options] [path]          Run the project's build, check the output
                                  (copies of three, missing assets, sub-path
                                  URLs, decoders) and open the built page
                                  headless
  model                           3D models for three.js without Blender:
                                  inspect, view, lint, identify, brief, spec,
                                  kinds, recipes, build
  ci [options] [path]             Review (and optionally the headless check) in
                                  one receipt, for CI and pull requests
  doctor [options] [path]         What is wrong in this project and in which
                                  order to fix it (grouped by cause, with next
                                  steps), then what Threesmith needs here (Node,
                                  three, Playwright, Chromium with WebGL)
  types [options] [path]          Run the project's tsc --noEmit and explain the
                                  three.js type errors with the installed
                                  release (did you mean, import paths)
  lessons [options] [query...]    Lessons from real three.js projects: by words,
                                  an error message, a rule or a topic; --id for
                                  one in full
  scan [options] [path]           Map the project: stack and versions, pages,
                                  files using three with what they create,
                                  renderer settings, assets
  assets [options] [path]         Check every asset path in the code: missing
                                  files, wrong capitals, decoder folders, glTF
                                  decoders the code ne
